author: Rob Loach
install_msg: Libretro installed. Have the bot owner run `[p]retroset download` to grab a Game Boy core, then play with `[p]retro` and an attached ROM. Save games players can start by name with `[p]retroset game add <name> <url>`.
name: Retro
short: Play Game Boy games in Discord
description: Play Game Boy games together in Discord. Start a game by name, URL, or an attached .gb/.gbc ROM (homebrew, or one you have the rights to) and control it with buttons under the screen. Every press posts an animated clip of the next few seconds. Games save automatically and pick up where they left off, even after the bot restarts. Emulated through libretro.
